typical_topologies: The AMBA AXI4-Stream protocol is a single-channel, point-to-point, unidirectional
The AXI4-Stream protocol is one of several point-to-point streaming interfaces.
- Single unidirectional point-to-point channel; master (source) to slave

multi_copy_atomicity.english: A system is multi-copy atomic iff (a) writes to the same location are observed in the same order by all agents AND (b) a write to a location that is observable by one agent is observable by all agents.
multi_copy_atomicity.required_for: Issue G and later of this specification (also required if Arm v8 architecture processors are connected).
implementation_options: MCA = false (system does NOT guarantee multi-copy atomicity; software must compensate)

id_routing.description: Interconnect may append bits to AxID to identify the originating master; slave-side ID_WIDTH > master-side ID_WIDTH
id_routing.compliance_note: Returning ID is the WIDER value; routing strips appended bits before returning to the master
id_routing.implication: A slave-port ID_WIDTH parameter must accommodate the maximum of (master-port ID_WIDTH + ceil(log2(number_of_masters_routed))) so that no two masters' IDs collide at the slave.

fields.interconnect_role: An AXI4-Stream interconnect routes streams between sources and sinks using TDEST (destination) and preserves per-stream ordering using TID. It may also adapt data widths and insert register slices for timing; it never adds an address phase (the protocol stays addressless).

ordering_guarantees.stream_ordering: Transfers within one TID/TDEST are delivered in order.
ordering_guarantees.cross_stream: Ordering between different TID/TDEST values is not defined by the protocol.

fields.memory_vs_peripheral_regions: Not applicable — AXI4-Stream is addressless. There are no memory or peripheral address regions; routing is by TID/TDEST, not by address.

slave_classification.Memory_slave: Required to handle all transaction types correctly. Memory slaves use Tables A9-1..A9-4 for default signal values when signals are omitted.
slave_classification.Peripheral_slave: Has an IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED method of access. Any non-conforming access must complete protocol-compliantly but the peripheral is not required to operate correctly under all access patterns; side effects per access; reorder restrictions; may support a subset of transaction types.

default_signal_values_evidence_tables: AMBA AXI4-Stream Protocol Specification (ARM IHI 0051) — signal roles and handshake
fields.ic_name: AMBA AXI4-Stream Protocol (ARM IHI 0051, Single Unidirectional Stream Channel)
fields.topology_type: Point-to-point unidirectional stream from a master (source) to a slave (sink). An AXI4-Stream interconnect (switch/multiplexer) can fan-in / fan-out / route multiple streams using TID/TDEST while preserving per-stream ordering. There is no address-mapped fabric.

supported_topologies.name: Fan-out
supported_topologies.description: One source broadcast/routed to several sinks via interconnect.

supported_topologies.name: Fan-in / multiplexing
supported_topologies.description: Several sources merged to one sink, routed/ordered by TID/TDEST.

supported_topologies.name: Switch
supported_topologies.description: Multi-port routing by TDEST, per-stream ordering by TID.

supported_topologies.name: Mixed system
supported_topologies.description: AXI4-Stream data path plus a memory-mapped AXI control interface.

master_slave_role_summary.description: Drives TVALID + TDATA + qualifiers; produces the stream.
Drives TREADY; consumes the stream (backpressure via TREADY).
Routes streams by TDEST and orders per TID.

device_classification.master_source: Data producer (video source, packet generator, DMA read).
device_classification.slave_sink: Data consumer (DMA write, packet processor, DSP block).
